read_protocol.frames: M4 frame = the groups R1 forms that R0 does not (a group of >= 2 adverts whose member set is not an R0 group). M5 frame = the R0 groups R1 breaks up: an R0 group that is neither an R1 group nor wholly inside an M4 group. An absorbed R0 group is asked about through the R1 group, as in autodedup/lab/page.py `splits`. Groups holding an advert flagged by post_export_checks are left out of both frames. seal_draw.py (sha256 298ef8d1916087cb8672913e17961348153b3ec07f03058059f0deb6904ed6ee) computes the frames, the draw and the screen, and governs over any other tool.
read_protocol.draw: each frame sorted by its sorted member-id tuple, then random.Random(20260927).shuffle(frame), drawn separately for each frame with a fresh generator; the first 40 of each are drawn (all of them if fewer than 40). seal_draw.py writes them to c19_reads/draw.json before any page is built.
read_protocol.screen: WAVES.md:87. seal_draw.py screens every M4 group not drawn. It applies C7's fused-shape screen (census/c7/scripts/screen.py): two members of one portal co-live for more than a day (honest_overlap_days > 1.0), or two priced members whose price paths do not agree (price_paths_agree(a, b, 0.005)). It adds the limb that screen is blind to, for sequential siblings: two members with the same broker_key. A sequential sibling of one broker with an agreeing price path reads the same as a re-post train, so every same-broker group is read, re-posts included. Every flagged group is HAND-READ; the rest are listed (count and member ids) in draw.json. Verified: on c17 N2_excl6 the screen reproduces all 12 of C7's flags, and on C7's c17 N2_off arm it hand-reads 41 of 178 undrawn groups (20 of them through the broker limb alone).
read_protocol.page: One private review page (B-i) per frame. The M4 page holds the 40 drawn cards, then every hand-read card (sorted by member tuple), all in one card format; the M5 page holds 40 cards. RP2c takes about 35 minutes for 80 cards at ~25 s a card, plus ~25 s per hand-read card. There is no cap: if the hand-read cards outlast the sitting, the read continues in a second sitting before R1's go/no-go, and the release waits (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 4 fallback 1). Each card shows every member's portal link and stated facts, and its decided pairs. The page says neither which arm formed a group nor whether a card was drawn or hand-read.
read_protocol.verdict: binary: 'One property' or 'Not one property'. A card left unanswered counts AGAINST R1: as fused in M4 (drawn or hand-read), as one property (a true group R1 lost) in M5.
read_protocol.classification_D7: Pre-registered (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 2.2, decision D7): a group is FUSED when any two members state a different value of any fact (area, floor or its wording, disposition, price while co-live, part of town, room size in the body, unit designator, cellar or accessory, ...), UNLESS an operator ruling covers the pair, or an operator ruling on a convention covers the difference (identical units are one property; a floor-numbering convention). 'Inside the engine's tolerance' is not an excuse. Undecidable counts against the arm. Standing rulings apply: a rental is never one property with a sale; a flat is never one property with a commercial unit; image tags are never facts. The operator reads; the operator's read is final (operator rulings override), and a 'One property' read against a stated difference is recorded with that difference.
read_protocol.wilson: The fused share of the DRAWN cards is reported with the 95 % Wilson interval; 0 of 40 bounds the fused share at <= 8.8 %. The hand-read cards are a census of the screened shapes, reported as counts.

bars.B2_gains: WAVES.md:87 (D83 + D91) on the seal, through M4 (section 2.2): 0 fused under D7 among the drawn R1-only groups AND among the hand-read ones (the screen's flags and every same-broker group). The R1-only groups that are neither drawn nor flagged are listed (count and member ids) in the read record. The operator-'different' clause is vacuous on c19 (no rulings), so the read alone decides.
bars.M5_losses: the reverse read (section 2.2): the drawn R0-only groups are read. Every 'One property' is a true group R1 loses, listed with the fact R1 reads between its members (`lab lost --why`, B1's form, run after the freeze). It is REPORTED with its Wilson interval, beside the estimate 'true groups gained minus lost' = (R1-only groups x M4 drawn one-property share) - (R0-only groups x M5 one-property share). B1 itself is read on the post-heal trial, c17 and c18 (section 3.5), not here.
bars.readouts: computed once, from the same two runs, at the same opening, never bars on c19: M7 (co-pairs gained / lost, groups changed, band size, largest group); certain-duplicate recall (cohort 16's pinned builder truth16.py, engine-free) R1 vs R0, against arm H's per-cohort bar (>= R0 - 0.10 pp, G4 section 6); same-body re-post trains newly split (arm H: 0); M9 decide wall R1 / R0.
bars.not_computable_here: M1, M2 (no operator rulings on c19), M3 (no fixture pair lives in c19), M6.

refusal_rule: ANY fused group among the drawn or hand-read R1-only groups (a 'Not one property' read or an unanswered card) REFUSES R1 as frozen on this ground: R1 is no-go at RP2c. The fused card is attributed from the two single-change arms (w31r1 minus image_tags; w31r1 minus d43_image_facts), run on c19 after the read, and GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 4's fallbacks 2 or 3 name what may ship; per 'second_read' any re-frozen R1 confirms on a fresh cohort. M5 does not refuse automatically: if the estimate of true groups gained minus lost is negative, the go / no-go is the operator's at RP2c with those numbers, recorded in the second addendum.
verdict_forms: GO (0 fused in M4, drawn and hand-read; M5 reported; estimate >= 0), OPERATOR (0 fused in M4, estimate < 0: the operator decides at RP2c), NO-GO (>= 1 fused in M4), VOID (post_export_checks flag > 1 %), NOT-MEASURABLE (a run or the freeze addendum is missing; B0 fails; the dump names no engine room; or R1's unscored count differs from the attach report's uncarried).
serves: R1's go / no-go at RP2c (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 4, D4 Thu 10-01) before the R1 release (D5 Fri 10-02); D2 and D8. Not R2: MF is judged on cohort 20.
